signMoods.Aries: Initiative, new beginnings, military assertiveness, leadership changes
signMoods.Taurus: Economy, trade, material security, banking, agriculture, values
signMoods.Gemini: Media, communication, information, transportation, mixed messages
signMoods.Cancer: Homeland, public mood, housing, patriotic sentiment
signMoods.Leo: Executive action, sovereignty, spectacle, national pride, creativity
signMoods.Virgo: Public health, workers, civil service, process, bureaucratic action
signMoods.Libra: Diplomacy, treaties, partnerships, justice, foreign agreements
signMoods.Scorpio: Intelligence, financial power plays, hidden agendas exposed, debt
signMoods.Sagittarius: Courts, law, religion, higher education, foreign affairs, philosophy
signMoods.Capricorn: Government authority, corporate actions, austerity, structural policy
signMoods.Aquarius: Technology disruptions, populist movements, reform, the unexpected
signMoods.Pisces: Propaganda, misinformation, compassion, spiritual surges, escape

Aries/Libra.seed: New Moon in Aries plants seeds of bold initiative -- new campaigns, executive orders, military gambits. The nation acts unilaterally.
Aries/Libra.harvest: Full Moon in Libra reveals whether those assertions produced fair outcomes or fractured alliances. Diplomacy is tested.
Aries/Libra.mundane: Watch for: treaty negotiations, trade deals stalling or finalizing, Supreme Court rulings on executive power, NATO/alliance tensions

Taurus/Scorpio.seed: New Moon in Taurus plants seeds around the economy, currency, agriculture, and tangible wealth. The focus is on what we own and value.
Taurus/Scorpio.harvest: Full Moon in Scorpio exposes the hidden debts, intelligence operations, and power plays lurking beneath the surface of financial calm.
Taurus/Scorpio.mundane: Watch for: Fed rate decisions, banking crises, intelligence leaks, debt ceiling drama, commodity shocks, tax policy fights

Gemini/Sagittarius.seed: New Moon in Gemini seeds media narratives, tech launches, transportation policy, and the sheer volume of information in circulation.
Gemini/Sagittarius.harvest: Full Moon in Sagittarius asks whether any of that information added up to truth. Courts, universities, and foreign correspondents weigh in.
Gemini/Sagittarius.mundane: Watch for: social media regulation, AI policy, free speech fights, university protests, foreign journalism crackdowns, Supreme Court media cases

Cancer/Capricorn.seed: New Moon in Cancer plants seeds of public feeling -- housing anxiety, immigration sentiment, patriotic fervor, family policy.
Cancer/Capricorn.harvest: Full Moon in Capricorn reveals how government structures respond (or fail to respond) to those feelings. Authority is tested.
Cancer/Capricorn.mundane: Watch for: housing market shifts, immigration executive orders, approval ratings, government shutdowns, austerity measures, infrastructure bills

Leo/Aquarius.seed: New Moon in Leo seeds acts of individual sovereignty -- executive spectacle, leadership ego, creative national identity.
Leo/Aquarius.harvest: Full Moon in Aquarius reveals whether the collective accepts or rejects that sovereignty. Populist movements surge or fracture.
Leo/Aquarius.mundane: Watch for: presidential addresses, tech monopoly hearings, grassroots movements, election reform, protest movements, crypto regulation

Virgo/Pisces.seed: New Moon in Virgo seeds practical reforms -- health policy, labor rules, supply chain fixes, bureaucratic reorganization.
Virgo/Pisces.harvest: Full Moon in Pisces reveals the spiritual or compassionate dimension that process alone cannot address. Propaganda and idealism collide.
Virgo/Pisces.mundane: Watch for: pandemic response, drug policy, VA and military health, misinformation campaigns, border compassion debates, religious freedom cases
